queries_run: Datadog export control OR entity list observability software 2026
Datadog China tariff OR trade restriction 2026
cloud software SaaS tariff exposure supply chain 2026

findings.claim: Datadog's own export control page (effective 2026-05-05) classifies its observability and security services as ECCN 5D002.c.1 under license exception ENC/740.17(b)(1); automation, incident management and AI products (e.g. Bits AI) as 5D992.c.1 under ENC/740.17(b)(1); and the Datadog Agent and other downloadable products (SDKs, IDE plugins) as EAR99 / NLR (no license required).

note: Only the export classification finding is sourced. Searches for Datadog + Section 232 / China tariff / entity list returned no Datadog-specific tariff or export-control item; the generic tariff and SaaS results were about other topics and carried no clear publication date, so they are not entered as claims. The Q2 2026 10-Q (ddog-20260630) was fetched once, but the summarizer reported no tariff or export-control language; that is a summary of a long document, not a full-text search, so it should not be treated as confirmation that the filing has none.
